Browser bundle: markdown-it 15.0.3, distributed under the MIT license.

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/markdown-it/v/15.0.3

`markdown-it.min.js` is the unmodified `dist/browser/markdown-it.umd.min.js`
from the npm package. The accompanying license is in `markdown-it.LICENSE`.
It is embedded locally in the admin page so rendering needs no external CDN.
